description: Split the WorkflowView god component (1455 lines) into per-file modules and reorganize runtime-decision presentation builders from per-builder to per-summary dimension.

tasks.title: Decompose WorkflowView into per-file sibling modules
tasks.description: Extract the 29 inline helpers, icons, and subcomponents from the 1455-line ui/WorkflowView.tsx into seven sibling files (format.ts, StageStatusIcons.tsx, StageBar.tsx, TaskItem.tsx, CheckItem.tsx, InlineApproval.tsx, failure-panels.tsx), each owning exactly the symbols prescribed by the spec's target-file table. Slim WorkflowView.tsx to composition-only (mounting StageBar → SpecialStatePanel → StepList → IntegrateFailurePanel in the prior conditional order). Move symbol bodies verbatim; rewire cross-file imports to import each symbol from its owning sibling. The view's private isScriptHealthCheck duplicate is carried into the appropriate ui/ sibling as-is and cleaned up in T-002.
acceptanceCriteria: ui/format.ts exists and owns classifyResult, formatDuration, formatClock, parseTimelineTaskOutput, formatOriginLabel, formatOriginTitle
ui/StageStatusIcons.tsx exists and owns the six status icons plus the StageStatusIcon dispatcher
ui/StageBar.tsx exists and owns StageBar, StageBarCell, getStageStatus, getStageDuration, workflowTimelineToStageStateMap
ui/TaskItem.tsx exists and owns TaskItem, TaskLifecycleTime, RunningElapsed, TaskSessionChip, TaskArtifactSummaryChip, RequiredFileEntry
ui/CheckItem.tsx exists and owns CheckItem, CheckRepairPanel
ui/InlineApproval.tsx exists and owns InlineApprovalControls, StepList
ui/failure-panels.tsx exists and owns DeliveryFailureBanner, IntegrateFailurePanel, SpecialStatePanel
ui/WorkflowView.tsx contains no inline definitions for the moved symbols; it only assembles the panels in the prior conditional order
Each moved symbol is defined in exactly one file (the one the spec table prescribes)
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes with WorkflowView.test.tsx unmodified (timeline/mobile/approval/request-changes/feedback/artifact/read-only scenarios all green)
tasks.output: Seven new ui/ sibling files plus a slimmed composition-only ui/WorkflowView.tsx
tasks.notes: Follow design D5 risk ordering within this task: extract format.ts + StageStatusIcons.tsx first (zero risk), then extract peer subcomponents in dependency order (StageBar → TaskItem → CheckItem → InlineApproval → failure-panels), then strip leftover inline debris from WorkflowView.tsx. Run typecheck + test after each internal extraction to keep a green gate.

tasks.title: Extract shared runtime query helpers into model/runtime-query-helpers.ts
tasks.description: Create model/runtime-query-helpers.ts owning the six pure timeline/state query helpers (findRunningTask, findFailedCheck, findRunningCheck, findFailedScriptHealthCheck, isScriptHealthCheck, formatStageLabel) that are currently duplicated between model/derive-runtime-decision.ts and the ui/ layer. Move the function bodies verbatim (no null/case-sensitivity behavior changes). Rewire derive-runtime-decision.ts and all ui/ consumers (including the isScriptHealthCheck copy carried into a ui/ sibling by T-001) to import from the new module. Delete every surviving private duplicate so each helper has exactly one definition.
acceptanceCriteria: model/runtime-query-helpers.ts exists and defines findRunningTask, findFailedCheck, findRunningCheck, findFailedScriptHealthCheck, isScriptHealthCheck, formatStageLabel exactly once
derive-runtime-decision.ts imports all six helpers from runtime-query-helpers.ts instead of defining them inline
No ui/ file defines a private copy of any of the six helpers; all ui/ consumers import from runtime-query-helpers.ts
Shared helpers behave identically to before (null/empty handling, case-insensitive status comparison, title/name fallback, stage-label title-casing over _/- separators)
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes with both derive-runtime-decision.test.ts and WorkflowView.test.tsx unmodified
tasks.output: model/runtime-query-helpers.ts plus rewired imports in derive-runtime-decision.ts and ui/ siblings
tasks.notes: Per design D2 the module lives under model/ (not ui/ or shared/) because the helpers inspect model-layer timeline types and derive-runtime-decision is the canonical heavy consumer. Move bodies byte-for-byte to avoid behavior drift.

tasks.title: Restructure runtime-decision presentation into a per-summary table
tasks.description: Reorganize the four presentation builders (buildHeadline, buildRationale, buildNextAction, buildActions) in model/derive-runtime-decision.ts from the per-builder dimension (each builder walking every RuntimeSummary via if-chains) to a per-summary dimension. Introduce a SummaryPresentationContext type and a Record<RuntimeSummary, SummaryPresentation> table whose entries are functions over that context, so one state's headline + rationale + nextAction + actions co-reside in one place. Add a module-private terminalActions helper (design D4) to deduplicate the shared failed/blocked retry/resume/rerun prefix while preserving the Start-vs-Stop tail divergence. Replace the four builders' bodies with PRESENTATIONS[summary].* lookups driven from deriveRuntimeDecision. Keep determineSummary, buildDriftNote, and cross-cutting resolvers (stopRecoverable, waitReason, driftNote, blockedReason, approvalStage) computed centrally. If the file stays above ~500 lines after the table is in place, split PRESENTATIONS into model/runtime-presentations.ts (design Open Question).
acceptanceCriteria: A Record<RuntimeSummary, SummaryPresentation> table (or equivalent per-summary structure) exists so that each RuntimeSummary value's headline, rationale, nextAction, and actions co-reside in one location

No per-builder function that branches over every RuntimeSummary value via if/switch chains remains for headline, rationale, nextAction, or actions; each projection is reached through the per-summary structure

RuntimeDecision output is byte-for-byte identical to before for every RuntimeSummary and every issue/timeline/agent input combination (classification precedence, headline/rationale/nextAction strings, action set/ordering/enablement/reasons, failed-vs-blocked Start-vs-Stop divergence, primary-action selection, stopRecoverable, waitReason, driftNote, blockedReason, approvalStage)
Record<RuntimeSummary, ...> provides compile-time exhaustiveness so a missing summary is a build failure
determineSummary remains a single classifier separated from the presentation layer; the presentation layer consumes the summary without re-deriving it
No RuntimeSummary or RuntimeActionKind value added or removed; RuntimeDecision and RuntimeDecisionInput interface shapes unchanged
npm run typecheck -w packages/web passes
npm run test:run -w packages/web passes with derive-runtime-decision.test.ts unmodified (classification precedence, current-task fallbacks, action matrix, drift notes all green)
tasks.output: Restructured model/derive-runtime-decision.ts (and optionally model/runtime-presentations.ts) with per-summary PRESENTATIONS table
tasks.notes: Per design D3 the table entries must be functions over a shared SummaryPresentationContext, not static templates, because headline/rationale interpolate currentTask.title and formatStageLabel, and actions depend on the allowed set and isClosed/isDone gating. Per design D4 the failed/blocked shared action block uses one terminalActions helper to avoid label/reason string drift. Keep SummaryPresentationContext module-private (design Open Question). This is the only logic-equivalence risk in the change; the derive-runtime-decision.test.ts oracle is the primary gate.
